dict.string: Datapilot Scout reads files on the Desktop only when you include it in a scan. Nothing is written to this Mac.
Datapilot Scout reads files in Documents only when you include it in a scan. Nothing is written to this Mac.
Datapilot Scout reads files in Downloads only when you include it in a scan. Nothing is written to this Mac.
Datapilot Scout runs from a USB stick and saves its results there. It reads other removable drives only when you select them.
Datapilot Scout reads network volumes only when you select them for a scan. Nothing is written to them.
